thread:
Maya: Quick sync — thinking through a cutover tolerance matrix + autofallback policy for canary/A-B rollouts. Want defaults that avoid cascade rollbacks but let us recover fast. Thoughts?
Omar: scope: do you mean per-stage thresholds (pct/latency/error) or a global circuit with stage-specific weights?
Maya: both. We need a matrix that maps signal -> per-stage threshold and an operator-facing global kill-switch. Default should be conservative.
Riya: runtime notes: we can evaluate signals at the request router and at the variant observer. Propose two signal planes: "infra" (latency, 5xx) and "quality" (evals on golden prompts). Autofallback policy should prefer graceful degrade (route to quantized/cheaper variant) before full rollback.
Pat: agree. Also add hysteresis and backoff to avoid flip-flopping. Circuit-breaker should have: min-eval-window, cooldown, max-rollbacks per 24h. We learned from last incident — aggressive auto rollback cascaded. :grimacing:
Riya: suggested config sketch (defaults):
```yaml
rollout:
  mode: canary
  stages:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 10m
      error_budget: 0.5%
    - pct: 25
      duration: 20m
      error_budget: 1.0%
fallback:
  prefer_degrade: true  # try cheaper variant first
  triggers:
    latency_p95: 2.0  # seconds
    error_rate: 1.0  # percent
    quality_regression: 0.02  # absolute drop vs golden set
  cooldown: 5m
  max_rollbacks_per_day: 2
  min_observation_requests: 100
```
Maya: Nice. Two questions: 1) who owns the tolerance matrix? 2) how do we expose overrides for Dedicated/private customers?
Omar: ownership: product + platform set a safe default; runtime owns enforcement; SRE owns runbooks/ops overrides. Overrides can be a per-deployment policy object that the control plane validates against a safety schema.
Pat: for Dedicated/private, we should allow operator-set thresholds but require a signed policy and an explicit ack for removing safety caps. Also surface telemetry alerts to oncall with suggested rollback vs degrade actions.
Riya: runtime hooks: we should expose live probe telemetry and a sample of failing traces to the console. Also support golden-prompt sampling — small evaluators that run asynchronously and report a quality score. Tie those scores into "quality_regression" trigger.
Maya: operational UX: defaults + 1-click quick rollback, and a safepath button to degrade to cheaper model variant instead of rollback. That should reduce blast radius. :thumbsup:
Omar: one more idea: a tolerance matrix UI that shows for each stage the relationship between pct -> allowed latency/error. Visualize heatmap so PMs can tune without guessing.
Pat: add SLO guardrails: don't allow stage >50% without manual approval. Also enforce max_rollbacks_per_day in the control plane to avoid thrash.
Riya: implementation notes: router emits per-variant counters per-window; observer aggregates windows and evaluates matrix. Keep evaluation deterministic and idempotent. Persist state in rollout-controller with an audit trail.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered: rollout v3 -> 5% (stage 1). Monitor channels: #incidents #telemetry.
Maya: Action items: Riya -> proto for observer evaluation API + sample config by EOD Wed; Omar -> mockup for tolerance matrix UI; Pat -> runbook draft for autofallback ops. I'll collate and post RFC follow-up next week. Thanks all :eyes:
